visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair and round glasses, wearing a tan jacket over a grey shirt, is walking on a sunny urban street in Paris, holding her phone for a selfie vlog. The background shows classic European buildings with light-colored stone facades, a red storefront awning, and parked cars under a clear blue sky. (2) The scene cuts to a view of a street intersection where a vintage red and white Citroen 2CV drives from left to right. Other modern cars and pedestrians are visible on the sidewalk in the bright daylight. (3) The perspective shifts to inside a car, looking out the rear passenger window. The woman's hand is visible gesturing toward an open window of an adjacent car outside. The interior of the car she is in shows a grey door panel and headrest. (4) The camera cuts back to a selfie view of the woman walking on the street. She continues talking, gesturing with her left hand near her nose to illustrate a point. The lighting is bright and natural with soft shadows on her face as she moves along the sidewalk.
